annotations.title: Read what moved a Desk pick’s Grade

description: One Desk pick’s number and the evidence that moved its Grade (GET desk/evidence): {pickId, label, book, oddsAmerican, fairPct (the Desk’s one fair chance for the bet), edgePct, grade {letter, score, startLetter (the letter the number alone gives)}, evidence {line, top, count, totalPoints}, contextLine (the Grade’s context sentence when nothing moved it, else null), oneNumber {legs [{method, start, evidencePoints, final}], evidence [every item: what, direction helps|hurts, points of chance, at, sourceName, sourceUrl, quote (the exact sentence from the source), sizedBy, line]}}. evidence is null when the pick has no Grade yet or nothing moved it; oneNumber is null when the pick has no Grade from the one-number rule; with no evidence item, oneNumber.line is the context sentence when the Grade holds one. Pro and up only. Reads only.
name: get_desk_evidence
title: Read what moved a Desk pick’s Grade
